title: Settle in
target: Two priority runs: Easy 1 and the longer run. Easy 2 is optional when recovered.
adjustment: Includes the completed 3 km on 22 Oct at its actual 6:46/km. Start the next outing gently and choose 4 km first; stop short or walk if needed. No catch-up sessions.

title: Build consistency
target: Two priority runs: Easy 1 and the longer run. Easy 2 is optional when recovered.
adjustment: Choose the lower distance first. Start gently for 5–10 minutes. Keep football as the hard effort; do not add intervals. Repeat week 1 if recovery is poor.

title: Extend gently
target: Two priority runs: Easy 1 and the longer run. Easy 2 is optional when recovered.
adjustment: Extend only after a comfortable previous longer run and normal recovery. Keep the whole longer run easy, including the finish; no fast-finish target.

title: Recovery week
target: Two priority runs: Easy 1 and the longer run. Easy 2 is optional when recovered.
adjustment: Lighter week: omit Easy 2 and absorb the training. Do not make up missed kilometres. Keep any strength work light and familiar.

title: Check endurance
target: Two priority runs: Easy 1 and the longer run. Easy 2 is optional when recovered.
adjustment: Use 8 km first. Reassess race participation and the time goal by 25 Nov using logged endurance and recovery; old PBs or one fast short run are not evidence of half-marathon readiness.

title: Longest training outing
target: Two priority runs: Easy 1 and the longer run. Easy 2 is optional when recovered.
adjustment: 10–12 km only after a comfortable 8–9 km and normal recovery; choose 10 first. Keep the finish easy. For outings over roughly 75–90 minutes, rehearse familiar carbohydrates and fluids; no first-time race-day experiments.

title: Ease down
target: Two priority runs: Easy 1 and the longer run. Easy 2 is optional when recovered.
adjustment: Taper: reduce volume, keep running relaxed, and omit Easy 2. Do not compensate with extra hard football, new speedwork, or a last-minute long run.

title: Race window
target: Optional short easy run, rest, then race day only if ready.
adjustment: Optional 2–3 km on 10 or 11 Dec; rest on 12 Dec. Start the race controlled, not faster to bank time. Reassess pace on hills or in heat; 5:55–5:59/km remains a conditional stretch goal, not a required starting pace.
